descriptions.payload_length: Total characters in URL path + query string + request body.
descriptions.shannon_entropy: Shannon entropy of the payload; high values indicate encoded or random content.
descriptions.digit_ratio: Fraction of numeric characters (hex/ASCII encoding signal).
descriptions.uppercase_ratio: Fraction of uppercase ASCII letters (keyword-style SQL signal).
descriptions.sql_keyword_score: Number of distinct SQL-injection keywords present.
descriptions.xss_keyword_score: Number of distinct XSS/script-injection keywords present.
descriptions.path_traversal_score: Number of distinct directory-traversal patterns present.
descriptions.user_agent_anomaly: 1 when the User-Agent names a known attack scanner, else 0.
descriptions.command_injection_score: Number of shell/RCE command-injection patterns present.
descriptions.hex_encoding_ratio: Fraction of payload characters consumed by %XX, \xXX or \uXXXX escapes.
descriptions.null_byte_score: 1 when a literal or encoded null byte is present, else 0.
descriptions.param_pollution_count: Number of duplicated parameter keys (HTTP parameter pollution).
descriptions.html_tag_density: Opening HTML/XML/SVG tags per whitespace token.
descriptions.request_method_risk: Risk weight of the HTTP verb (GET 0.1 ... TRACE 1.0).
descriptions.suspicious_extension_flag: 1 when the path ends in a backup/config/source extension, else 0.
descriptions.quote_count: Total single/double quote characters, raw or percent-encoded.
descriptions.angle_count: Total angle-bracket characters, raw or percent-encoded.
descriptions.max_value_special_ratio: Highest non-alphanumeric, non-space ratio among parameter values.
descriptions.max_value_length: Length of the longest query or form parameter value.
